name: Meng-Xi Guo
evidence: Shared-paper approach: rows 107 and 108 are co-authors of the same paper, so both were worked with two joint queries: '"Cross-Cultural Scenario Benchmark: Evaluating LLMs" corresponding author email Guo Gao' and '"Cross-Cultural Scenario Benchmark" bdcc "Meng-Xi Guo" OR "Lei-Ming Gao" Xiamen author email correspondence'. Both located the paper (MDPI Big Data and Cognitive Computing, doi.org/10.3390/bdcc10090290) and confirmed the affiliation anchor -- the work builds on the Chinese-Foreign Cultural Differences Case Repository at Xiamen University (9342 cases, 151 countries). MDPI normally prints a correspondence address in the author block, but neither search returned any part of that block, and mdpi.com and doi.org are both egress-blocked so the article page could not be opened. No address, no institutional domain, and no GitHub handle surfaced. Nothing templatable was accepted.
